verdict.rationale: ClickUp's first-party MCP server docs list creating release notes from tasks and docs as a supported use case. However, this depends on an external AI assistant being prompted. There is no documented per-release changelog trigger or automation, and the GitHub commit/PR sync only feeds the underlying data. Missing for 10: automatic per-release changelog generation, a native release/version concept tied to changelogs, documented output format, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
